 US air regulators have issued a nationwide ground stop for departing flights, citing a communications problem. 
 live play video play video This video may contain light patterns or images that could trigger seizures or cause discomfort for people with visual sensitivities. By Leena Fraihat and Enes Abuomer Published On 13 Nov 2026 13 Nov 2026 Save

 Air regulators in the United States issued a nationwide ground stop for departing flights at 3:54pm Eastern Time (20:54 GMT), citing a communications problem affecting air traffic control towers.
 Pacific-bound and transatlantic flights have been cleared to depart, according to San Francisco airport and Boston Logan airport.
